description: This file defines the MergeRecord class, a core component in the SuiteCRM system for managing record merging operations. It includes properties for handling multiple beans, loading their data, and generating search and where clauses for database queries related to merging records.

classes.name: MergeRecord
classes.description: Represents a record that merges other records in SuiteCRM, managing related beans, executing search queries, and handling ACL permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that optionally loads a merge bean if provided.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a record by ID, with special handling during 'Step2' actions.

methods.name: load_merge_bean
methods.description: Loads a merge bean for the specified module and optional ID.

methods.name: load_merge_bean2
methods.description: Loads a second merge bean for another module and optional ID.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Delegates to the merge bean to fill in list view fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Delegates to the merge bean to fill in detail view fields.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a summary text from the merge bean.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Returns list view data from the merge bean.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a generic WHERE clause delegating to the merge bean.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for the merge bean.

methods.name: populate_search_params
methods.description: Populates search parameters for query building based on input.

methods.name: get_inputs_for_search_params
methods.description: Generates hidden input HTML elements for search parameters.

methods.name: email_addresses_query
methods.description: Creates a subquery string for email address filtering.

methods.name: release_name_query
methods.description: Creates a subquery for release name filtering.

methods.name: create_where_statement
methods.description: Generates a combined WHERE clause from search parameters.

methods.name: generate_where_statement
methods.description: Concatenates multiple WHERE clauses with AND.
